Northwind Logistics Employee Leave Policy SOP-HR-014. This standard operating procedure defines annual leave entitlement for all permanent employees. New employees accrue annual leave at a rate of one point five days per completed month of service and become eligible to take annual leave after completing their ninety day probation period. Annual leave requests must be submitted through the HR portal at least ten working days in advance and require line manager approval. Unused annual leave up to five days may be carried forward into the next calendar year; any balance above five days is forfeited on the thirty first of December. Sick leave requires a medical certificate when the absence exceeds two consecutive working days. Parental leave of sixteen weeks is available to primary caregivers after twelve months of continuous employment. Bereavement leave of three days is granted for the loss of an immediate family member. Managers must record every approved leave request in the payroll system before the monthly payroll cutoff.
